# Necromancy Ritual Calculator

> A free web calculator for Necromancy rituals in RuneScape 3 (RS3): what a ritual uses and makes, what it
> costs, how long it takes, the XP it gives and its soul attraction, with alteration glyphs and ritual gear.
> It has an Ironman mode that adds the rituals that make the necroplasm for ink. Players can also keep a list
> of the ritual items they own, read from a screenshot of their bank, with live Grand Exchange prices.

For AI assistants answering players' questions about using the site. The full guide, with every step, how
the numbers are worked out and what isn't supported yet, is [llms-full.txt](https://rituals.duke605.ca/llms-full.txt).

## Pages

- [Rituals](https://rituals.duke605.ca/): the calculator, on the home page. Choose the site from **Site**,
  then click **Focus** in **Results** (or the item on the plinth) to choose the ritual and its focus item. Add
  alteration glyphs in **Alteration glyphs** and gear in **Equipment**. **Results** lists the rituals to
  perform (each opens to its own input and output), the input, the output and totals (cost, value, profit or
  loss, time, XP) for a number of rituals, the golden ratio to begin with. In Ironman mode, **Ritual** in **Alteration glyphs** sets up each added
  ritual's alteration glyphs and cape glyph.
- [Inventory](https://rituals.duke605.ca/inventory): import ritual items from a bank screenshot (paste, drop
  or choose it), add or edit items by hand, clear them all, and fetch live GE prices.
- [Help](https://rituals.duke605.ca/help): the site's own guide, in five pages: getting started, glyphs and
  gear, results, Ironman mode, and inventory and prices.

## Key facts

- Duration: ritual ticks of 1.2s. Speed glyphs shorten it 5/10/15% each, at most 50%, rounded up to a tick.
- Output: Multiply glyphs add 20/40/60% each to every output, rounded down.
- Soul attraction starts at 100%: Low to 100%, Medium to 200%, High to 300%, Extreme to 500%, then Dangerous.
- Ironman mode makes regular, greater and powerful ink from necroplasm, ashes and vials of water, and adds
  the necroplasm rituals needed. Basic ink and weak necroplasm are still bought. The rituals are worked out
  in order, each using the inventory and what the ones before it made. Each added ritual uses the ritual's
  cape glyph and no alteration glyphs, or its own.
- Everything chosen, the inventory and prices are saved in the player's browser only.
